summary: Frontend-only regression testing executed on public URL for desktop and mobile (focused runs). Verified: font inventory/load, text outline workflow, shape creation/default positions, large-size limits, thin-line hit area selection, object guides, upload size/format handling, localStorage+IndexedDB persistence, preview/export trigger, and mobile layout constraints (390x844).

ui_bugs.issue: Center guides did not appear during real drag when moving thin line near visual center target in desktop run; object guides appeared normally.

integration_issues.issue: With grid enabled and snap enabled, dragged line position had non-quantized Y coordinate (x quantized, y not), contrary to expected full grid quantization away from smart anchors.

integration_issues.flow: Mobile screenshot evidence collection for font picker/shape properties/outline
integration_issues.issue: Automation could not reliably transition from mobile curve/actions state into font picker panel using current scripted selector path; required screenshots for all requested mobile states remain partial.

action_items: Investigate center-guide trigger conditions in drag path so [data-kind='centre'] appears reliably at canvas center.
Review alignObject/grid interaction so grid+snap yields quantized coordinates consistently when not intentionally snapped to non-grid smart anchors.
Provide/confirm deterministic mobile panel navigation state for automated capture of font picker, shape-properties, and outlined-text screenshots.
Re-run full mobile matrix (390x844, 375x667, 320x568) once mobile panel path is stabilized.
critical_code_review_comments: State-dependent panel routing on mobile (curve/actions/edit/fonts) is difficult to drive deterministically in automation; consider explicit test ids/state hooks for direct panel transitions.
Quantization behavior appears sensitive to simultaneous smart-anchor detection; expected/actual priority between smart guides and grid snapping should be clarified in code/comments and tests.
No backend/API dependency observed for tested flows; storage and editor state are correctly local-first (localStorage + IndexedDB).
test_credentials: No auth flow in current scope. /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but contains placeholders only.
seed_data_creation: Created local test fixtures only: /app/tests/fixtures (valid_under10_a.jpg, valid_9mb.jpg (>10MB), malformed_fake.png).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Strongly validated passes: 15 fonts present; document.fonts loaded 14/14 Google/target faces; outline/fill and curve interactions work; shape defaults at translate(300 345); line width accepts 350mm; thin-line hit area >=44px and offset drag works; object guides appear; upload acceptance/rejection and persistence passed; preview excludes guides/grid and has clipping defs; export download trigger passed. Partial/failed: centre guides and grid+snap quantization expectation; mobile screenshot capture path remained unstable in scripted navigation.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (centre guides): During drag, alignObject may select nearest object anchors and skip center alignment unless delta threshold and anchor index conditions are met simultaneously, causing no [data-kind='centre'] guide even near center. Repro: add line, drag near canvas center, inspect alignment-guide selectors while pointer down. RCA-2 (grid+snap): When both snap and grid are enabled, a nearest non-center anchor may partially override grid quantization for one axis; observed y retained decimal units while x snapped to grid. Repro: add long line, enable grid+snap, drag near other object anchors, inspect transform translate values.
